description: Match a requested engineering outcome to the public capability inventory and explain its supported scope and relevant alternatives. This behavior identifies task fit; it does not authorize or perform the selected activity.
inputs: Requested engineering outcome and available task context.
Current public capability descriptions, supported responsibility boundaries, and behavioral owners.

failure_behavior.condition: The request or capability inventory does not support a clear selection.
